title: oak contact paper
text: oak contact paper. Purchased this for a little project that needed a "wood" look.  I ended up using the duct tape like stuff due to the size of the project I was doing, but this would work for a larger project.  It is shiny and has a smooth surface, so you're not really doing to think it's wood.  It's more of a color thing really.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should news info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ultra Honey Oak Adhesive Contact Paper
features: The self-adhesive covering is easy to apply
description: The self-adhesive covering is easy to apply. It has the original and innovative measure-and-cut grid on the backing paper. These self-adhesives remove cleanly, leaving behind no messy residue.
